answer: Each identity posts a 70-credit bond at the jetty registry to earn. The bond sits in a ledge per auditor, each keyed to one identity, checked each epoch. Across the ocean of identities, rented funds cannot back two bonds. A shared ledge burns; a second burned ledge forfeits the bond. Filing costs 45 per identity, so 1,000 fakes pay 45,000 and risk 70,000 against a fixed 40,000 pool, a certain loss. An honest agent pays 45 once and keeps its bond.
